name: Gray Beard

text.ability: Once a round at the colony, Gray Beard takes one random card from another player's hand. Not used in the co-op variant.
text.bio: Treats other people's belongings as an opening offer.

notes: Clean scan Survivor_Gray_Beard.jpg matches influence, attack, search, ability location, die value and once-per-round limit. The Vassal module files him with the promos; kept because our 30-survivor roster carries him. The scan carries the not-in-co-op marker.
